focuses.name: Unbreakable Aegis
focuses.description: Aegis Barrier +20%. While Aegis is active, damage taken -10%. Aegis prevents one interrupt, stun, silence, knockback, or displacement effect.

focuses.name: Second Wind
focuses.description: If you would take lethal damage while at 75+ Guard, consume 75 Guard, prevent death, set Health to 1, immediately activate Aegis at 75 Guard strength, and heal for 6% Max Health over 4 seconds. 120 second cooldown.

focuses.name: Counterpoise
focuses.description: When Aegis breaks or expires, your next Essence ability within 8 seconds gains up to +12% Effect Potency based on damage absorbed by Aegis.
